messages:
Rae (Design): quick sketch dropped — proposal: add a p95 delta compare pill that pins while dragging the scrubber, and a compact legend toggle (density vs buckets) to help interpret heatmap sampling. figma: https://figma.com/... :mag_right:
Theo (PM): interesting. product question: should delta compare default to off? it could be noisy on sampled ranges.
Cal (Frontend): agree default off for sampled ranges. impl notes: scrubbing fires heatmap queries; recommend debounce 100ms and short client smoothing (1s) for delta UI. backend can return `meta.sampled` so client can auto-disable delta compare if sampled=true.
Jo (SRE): telemetry request: emit `viz.delta_compare_used` and `viz.legend_density_toggle` events. also add `viz.sampled_reason` (range/rowcount) to payload so we can correlate sampling to missed signals.
Nora (A11y): quick a11y list:
- pinned delta pill must be focusable and announce "p95 delta: +42ms" when value changes; use aria-live polite for updates
- legend toggle must be a proper switch with aria-checked and keyboard support
- when delta compare is disabled due to sampling, announce "Delta compare disabled: sampling active" via aria-live
figma-bot: created PR #6150 for "p95-delta-pin + legend-toggle" assigned to @Cal and @Nora :robot_face:
Rae (Design): copy thoughts: pill label = "p95 Δ" hover text = "Difference from range start; disabled on sampled data". legend options: "Density" and "Bucketed".
Theo (PM): short copy sounds good. show an inline disabled state with tooltip explaining sampling conflict.
Cal (Frontend): locking on debounce=100ms, smoothing=1s. will read `meta.sampled` and disable delta compare client-side. PR incoming.
Jo (SRE): i'll add telemetry and dashboard for `viz.delta_compare_used` so we can see how often the feature masks anomalies.
Nora (A11y): i'll test NVDA + VoiceOver and validate aria-live messages and keyboard flow: scrubber -> presets -> legend toggle -> p95 Δ pill.
Rae (Design): thanks team — next steps: Cal implements, Nora reviews a11y, Jo wires telemetry, Theo approves copy. will update figma after PR merges :sparkles:
